pageIntro: House of Bread Ministries is an Apostolic church serving the Bronx and Westchester communities from Mount Vernon, New York.
storyTitle: From a living room gathering to a growing church family.
storyText1: Founded in 2005 by Pastor Windell Lyne and Evangelist Jacqueline Lyne, the ministry began with a small family gathering in a Bronx living room and has grown into a church family worshiping in Mount Vernon.
storyText2: The name House of Bread reflects a ministry committed to meeting spiritual and practical needs through Christ. We seek to be a house of worship, love, service, and the abiding presence of God.
missionTitle: Reach, restore, and renew through Jesus Christ.
missionText: Our mission is to reach people who feel lost, broken, or disconnected and bring hope and restoration through the love of Jesus Christ.
visionText: To pursue meaningful transformation in Mount Vernon and neighboring communities while continuing the renewal and restoration of our historic building, inviting people into new life in Christ.

values.title: Acknowledgement
values.text: Acknowledge God's sovereignty and trust Him in every season of life.

values.title: Serve
values.text: Serve with humility, putting the needs of others ahead of recognition.

values.title: Pray
values.text: Pray intentionally, consistently, and with faith in God's power.

values.title: Live
values.text: Live with integrity so our words, choices, and actions reflect Christ.

values.title: Worship
values.text: Worship with intensity and wholehearted devotion to God.

values.title: Love
values.text: Love God and His children passionately through grace, compassion, and action.

beliefs.title: The One True God
beliefs.text: We believe in one true and eternal God, Creator of heaven and earth, revealed as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

beliefs.title: The Deity of Jesus Christ
beliefs.text: Jesus Christ is fully God and fully man. He was born of a virgin, lived without sin, performed miracles, died for our sins, rose bodily from the dead, and ascended to heaven.

beliefs.title: Baptism in the Holy Spirit
beliefs.text: Believers should seek the baptism in the Holy Spirit, a distinct experience that empowers Christians for service and witness.

beliefs.title: Initial Physical Evidence
beliefs.text: We believe speaking in other tongues as the Spirit gives utterance is the initial physical evidence of the baptism in the Holy Spirit.

beliefs.title: The Bible
beliefs.text: The Bible is the inspired Word of God and our final authority for faith, doctrine, and Christian conduct.

beliefs.title: The Fall of Man
beliefs.text: Humanity was created good but fell through disobedience, bringing sin and separation from God.

beliefs.title: The Salvation of Man
beliefs.text: Salvation comes through repentance and faith in Jesus Christ. Through God's grace we receive justification, regeneration, and new birth by the Holy Spirit.

beliefs.title: Sanctification
beliefs.text: Sanctification is both an immediate and continuing work of grace that separates believers from sin and enables holy living.

beliefs.title: The Ordinances of the Church
beliefs.text: We observe water baptism by immersion in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ for the remission of sins and Holy Communion in remembrance of Christ's death and promised return.

beliefs.title: The Church and Its Mission
beliefs.text: The Church is the Body of Christ, called to evangelize the world, worship God, and build believers toward Christlikeness.

beliefs.title: Divine Healing
beliefs.text: Divine healing is part of the gospel, and we believe God still heals in response to faith and prayer.

beliefs.title: The Blessed Hope
beliefs.text: We believe in the imminent return of Jesus Christ and the gathering of His Church to be with Him.

beliefs.title: The New Heavens and New Earth
beliefs.text: We believe God will create a new heaven and a new earth where righteousness dwells forever.
